title: Sandwich Tycoon
features: Auto Grabs (Sandwiches) around the map, giving you thousands or millions of dollars in a few seconds
script:
_G.sandwichLoop = true

spawn(function()
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    while _G.sandwichLoop do
        local character = player.Character
        if character then
            local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if humanoidRootPart then
                for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                    if (part.Name == "Sandwich" or part.Name == "GoldenSandwich" or part.Name == "DiamondSandwich") and _G.sandwichLoop then
                        humanoidRootPart.CFrame = part.CFrame
                        wait(0.1)
                        if part:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector") then
                            part.ClickDetector:FireServer()
                        end
                        wait(0.1)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        wait(0.1)
    end
end)
